Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime

@NullMarked package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime
Runtime manifests, versioned test plans and process coordination shared across Maven, JUnit and the in-server agent. ModuleTestPlan records module ownership and supported Maven build context; MavenRuntimeContext ties a variant's immutable inputs to its real producer. Build leases protect packaging and capture, while runtime manifests describe independently mutable server sessions.
